~~~python
# Replace src/rush/tools/iac.py::IacTool.run (existing module imports remain).
def run(self, path, *, config=None, scope="module", plan_evidence=None,
        trial_plan_impact=None,state_fixture=None,provider_fixture=None,
        allowed_destroy_ids=(),runtime_path=None,image_ref=None,permissions=None):
    import hashlib, json
    from ..engines import ENGINES
    from .common import error_result, skipped_result
    if scope not in {"file", "module"}:
        return error_result(self.name, None, "scope must be file or module")
    root = (path if path.is_dir() else path.parent).resolve()
    requested = sorted({p.resolve() for p in collect_files(path, set(self.extensions))
                        if p.resolve().is_relative_to(root)})
    if not requested:
        return skipped_result(self.name, None, "no Terraform source files")
    modules = sorted({p.parent for p in requested})
    children = [run_engine(ENGINES[name], module, [], tool_name=self.name)
                for module in modules for name in self.engine_names]
    result = aggregate_results(self.name, children)
    requested_set = {str(p) for p in requested}
    all_findings = list(result.get("findings", []))
    def is_requested(finding):
        target = Path(finding.get("path", ""))
        target = (target if target.is_absolute() else root / target).resolve()
        return str(target) in requested_set
    context_findings = [f for f in all_findings if not is_requested(f)]
    if scope == "file":
        result["findings"] = [f for f in all_findings if is_requested(f)]
    metadata = result.setdefault("metadata", {})
    metadata["scope"] = {
        "requested_files": sorted(requested_set),
        "module_context_files": sorted(str(p.resolve()) for m in modules for p in m.glob("*.tf")
                                       if p.resolve().is_relative_to(root)),
        "reported_findings_scope": scope,
        "dependency_context_diagnostics": {
            "count": len(context_findings),
            "status": ("fail" if any(f.get("severity") == "error" for f in context_findings)
                       else "warn" if context_findings else "ok"),
            "paths": sorted({str(f.get("path", "")) for f in context_findings}),
        },
        "children": children,
    }
    metadata["coverage_complete"] = all(c["status"] not in {"skipped", "error"} for c in children)
    if not metadata["coverage_complete"] and result["status"] == "ok":
        result["status"] = "warn"
    if plan_evidence is not None:
        plan = Path(plan_evidence)
        plan = (plan if plan.is_absolute() else root / plan).resolve()
        if not plan.is_relative_to(root) or not plan.is_file():
            return error_result(self.name, None, "saved plan outside selected root or absent")
        try:
            raw = plan.read_bytes()
            document = json.loads(raw)
            if not isinstance(document, dict) or not isinstance(document.get("resource_changes"), list):
                raise ValueError("invalid saved plan")
            resources = {}
            for change in document["resource_changes"]:
                if (not isinstance(change, dict) or not isinstance(change.get("address"), str)
                    or not isinstance(change.get("change"), dict)
                    or not isinstance(change["change"].get("actions"), list)
                    or change["address"] in resources):
                    raise ValueError("invalid or duplicate plan resource")
                resources[change["address"]] = change["change"]["actions"]
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            return error_result(self.name, None, "saved Terraform JSON plan malformed")
        digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        links = []
        for finding in result.get("findings", []):
            address = finding.get("resource_address") or finding.get("resource")
            links.append({"rule":finding.get("rule"),"path":finding.get("path"),
                "resource_address":address if isinstance(address,str) else None,
                "actions":resources.get(address) if isinstance(address,str) else None,
                "linked":isinstance(address,str) and address in resources,
                "unlinked_reason":(None if isinstance(address,str) and address in resources
                                   else "finding has no matching explicit resource address")})
        metadata["plan_digest"] = digest
        metadata["plan_evidence"] = {"sha256":digest,"resource_count":len(resources),
                                     "finding_links":links}
    if trial_plan_impact is not None:
        if not state_fixture or not runtime_path or not image_ref:
            return error_result(self.name,None,"trial requires state_fixture and approved runtime/image")
        try:
            trial=globals()["trial_plan_impact"](root,trial_plan_impact,state_fixture,
                provider_fixture=provider_fixture,allowed_destroy_ids=allowed_destroy_ids,
                runtime_path=runtime_path,image_ref=image_ref,permissions=permissions)
        except Exception as exc:
            return error_result(self.name,"terraform",type(exc).__name__)
        metadata["plan_impact_trial"]=trial
        if trial["status"]=="blocked" and result["status"] not in {"fail","error"}:
            result["status"]="fail"
    return result

**Distinct agent-side expansion (proposed; unexecuted):** Add destructive-impact counterfactual to `src/rush/tools/iac.py::IacTool.run`. Existing Checkov/TFLint and saved-plan digest do not test whether a candidate configuration change destroys resources. Proposed operation applies one candidate patch in isolated module copy, runs matching Terraform plan with disposable state/provider fixtures, parses before/after action sets, and blocks candidate when a new delete/replace appears outside allowed resource IDs. No apply path exists.

~~~python
# Add src/rush/tools/iac.py::trial_plan_impact.
# Image contract: git + Terraform + locked offline providers. Both plans use
# identical copied state; this operation never calls init, refresh, or apply.
def trial_plan_impact(root, patch_path, state_fixture, *, runtime_path, image_ref,
                      allowed_destroy_ids=(), provider_fixture=None, permissions=None):
    import hashlib, json, shutil, tempfile
    from pathlib import Path
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    from ..runtime.isolated_process import run_isolated_argv
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    allowed, missing = check_permissions(
        ExecutionPermissions(build=True,slow=True,artifact_write=True),permissions)
    if not allowed:
        raise PermissionError(", ".join(missing))
    root = root.resolve(); physical = PhysicalRoot(root)
    patch = physical.open_contained(patch_path,purpose="read").read_bytes()
    state = physical.open_contained(state_fixture,purpose="read").read_bytes()
    json.loads(state)
    lock = physical.open_contained(".terraform.lock.hcl",purpose="read").read_bytes()
    for file in root.rglob("*"):
        if ".rush" in file.relative_to(root).parts or ".git" in file.relative_to(root).parts:
            continue
        if file.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("module/provider symlinks require materialized pinned fixture")
    if not isinstance(allowed_destroy_ids,(list,tuple)) or any(
        not isinstance(address,str) for address in allowed_destroy_ids):
        raise ValueError("allowed_destroy_ids must be string list")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-plan-trial-") as folder:
        scratch = Path(folder)
        for name in ("baseline","candidate"):
            shutil.copytree(root,scratch/name,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".git",".rush"))
            (scratch/name/"terraform.tfstate").write_bytes(state)
            if provider_fixture is not None:
                supplied=physical.open_contained(provider_fixture,purpose="read")
                if not supplied.is_dir():
                    raise ValueError("provider_fixture must be initialized .terraform directory")
                destination=scratch/name/".terraform"
                if destination.exists():
                    shutil.rmtree(destination)  # Only this fresh private copy is removed.
                shutil.copytree(supplied,destination)
        (scratch/"candidate.patch").write_bytes(patch)
        def child(entrypoint,argv,timeout):
            return run_isolated_argv(root,scratch,runtime_path=runtime_path,image_ref=image_ref,
                                     entrypoint=entrypoint,argv=argv,timeout_s=timeout)
        checked=child("git",["-C","/out/candidate","apply","--check","/out/candidate.patch"],30)
        if checked.returncode:
            raise ValueError("candidate patch does not apply")
        applied=child("git",["-C","/out/candidate","apply","/out/candidate.patch"],30)
        if applied.returncode:
            raise ValueError("candidate patch failed")
        # Revalidate every candidate path before any host read after patching.
        candidate_root = PhysicalRoot(scratch/"candidate")
        for file in (scratch/"candidate").rglob("*"):
            candidate_root.open_contained(file.relative_to(scratch/"candidate"),purpose="read")
        def provider_hashes(directory):
            base=directory/".terraform"
            return {p.relative_to(base).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    for p in base.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
        if provider_hashes(scratch/"baseline") != provider_hashes(scratch/"candidate"):
            raise ValueError("candidate altered provider fixture")
        # Provider/state identity cannot be altered by the candidate patch.
        if (candidate_root.open_contained(".terraform.lock.hcl",purpose="read").read_bytes()!=lock or
            candidate_root.open_contained("terraform.tfstate",purpose="read").read_bytes()!=state):
            raise ValueError("candidate altered state or provider lock")
        plans={}
        for name in ("baseline","candidate"):
            proc=child("terraform",["-chdir=/out/"+name,"plan","-input=false",
                "-refresh=false","-lock=false","-out=/out/"+name+".plan"],180)
            if proc.returncode:
                raise ValueError(name+" plan failed; no impact claim")
            shown=child("terraform",["-chdir=/out/"+name,"show","-json",
                                    "/out/"+name+".plan"],30)
            if shown.returncode:
                raise ValueError(name+" plan export failed")
            report=json.loads(shown.stdout)
            changes=report.get("resource_changes")
            if not isinstance(changes,list):
                raise ValueError("resource_changes missing")
            actions={}
            for resource in changes:
                address=resource["address"]; values=resource["change"]["actions"]
                if (not isinstance(address,str) or address in actions or
                    not isinstance(values,list) or not values or
                    any(v not in {"no-op","create","read","update","delete","forget"} for v in values)):
                    raise ValueError("unsupported plan actions")
                actions[address]=values
            plans[name]={"actions":actions,
                         "digest":hashlib.sha256(shown.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}
    prior={k for k,v in plans["baseline"]["actions"].items() if "delete" in v}
    next_={k for k,v in plans["candidate"]["actions"].items() if "delete" in v}
    introduced=next_-prior
    return {"operation":"plan_impact_trial","applied":False,"plans":plans,
            "state_digest":hashlib.sha256(state).hexdigest(),
            "provider_lock_digest":hashlib.sha256(lock).hexdigest(),
            "patch_digest":hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),
            "new_destructive_ids":sorted(introduced),
            "status":"blocked" if introduced-set(allowed_destroy_ids) else "candidate"}

## Command 17/79 — `rush_secrets` (Q17)

**CLI/MCP/agent-memory-token integration:** Scope/challenge/config fields need catalog Click forwarding and matching `SecretsTool.__call__` fields for FastMCP. Agents consume redacted findings and challenge receipts in `ToolResult`; `rush_secrets` has no current memory or token-budget path. Persisted fingerprints must remain secret-free evidence passed through separate memory commands.

**Use:** inspect selected source/history scope before sharing artifacts. Gitleaks adapter requests JSON and redacts sensitive messages (`tools/secrets.py:21–27`, `engines/gitleaks.py:27–44,74–94`).

**Source-confirmed defect:** Exit 1 with empty parsed findings returns ok (`engines/gitleaks.py:66–89`). That may represent a parser/output problem rather than absence of secrets. Neither secret bytes nor unredacted stderr may be used as diagnostic shortcuts.

**Fix specification:** In `src/rush/engines/gitleaks.py::normalize`, require exit 0 plus valid empty list for clean and exit 1 plus at least one valid finding for detection; exit 1/`[]`, silent output, malformed JSON, or exit >1 become error with redacted diagnostic and `terminal_reason`. `src/rush/tools/secrets.py::SecretsTool.run` exposes `scope=working_tree|history` and selects corresponding explicit Gitleaks argv; default preserves current legacy detect/history behavior and metadata states what was scanned. The route requires a directory and reports full directory/Git-history scope. Never copy `Secret`/`Match` into ToolResult, logs or artifacts. Fingerprint rule/path/location **and current source-file SHA-256**, and persist a digest map of the full working tree excluding `.git/.rush`, including clean scans. Capture that map before scanning and reject any change afterward; only unchanged source can be called recurring. Git-history continuity needs commit/blob identity, so current-file continuity rejects history mode.

**Non-innovative product expansion (proposed):** Add optional prior fingerprint set bound to source digest to distinguish recurring findings without storing secret bytes. Capability test: `tests/test_secrets.py::test_fingerprint_continuity_without_secret` matches source-bound prior ID and confirms serialized result contains no token bytes.

**Acceptance (proposed):** `tests/test_secrets.py::test_exit_one_empty_is_error`; `::test_synthetic_secret_redacted_everywhere` scans fake token `abc123...` and asserts token absent from serialized result/error/artifacts; `::test_history_scope_explicit` captures argv and scope field.

# Replace src/rush/engines/gitleaks.py::GitleaksEngine.normalize.
def normalize(self, raw, path, tool_name):
    try:
        reports = json.loads(raw.get("stdout", ""))
        if not isinstance(reports, list):
            raise ValueError("not a list")
        for item in reports:
            if (not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("File"), str)
                or not item["File"] or not isinstance(item.get("RuleID"), str)
                or not item["RuleID"] or type(item.get("StartLine")) is not int
                or item["StartLine"] < 1):
                raise ValueError("invalid finding")
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return error_result(tool_name, self.name, "gitleaks report malformed",
            duration_ms=raw.get("duration_ms", 0), terminal_reason="malformed_output")
    code = raw.get("exit_code")
    if type(code) is not int or code not in (0, 1) or (code == 1) != bool(reports):
        return error_result(tool_name, self.name, "gitleaks exit/report mismatch",
            duration_ms=raw.get("duration_ms", 0), terminal_reason="report_exit_mismatch")
    root = (path if path.is_dir() else path.parent).resolve()
    findings = []
    for item in reports:
        target = Path(item["File"])
        target = (target if target.is_absolute() else root / target).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(root):
            return error_result(tool_name, self.name, "gitleaks path outside target",
                                terminal_reason="malformed_output")
        findings.append({"path": str(target), "line": item["StartLine"],
            "rule": item["RuleID"], "severity": "error", "message": "Potential secret detected"})
    return ToolResult(tool=tool_name, engine=self.name,
        engine_version=self.version(), status="fail" if findings else "ok",
        duration_ms=raw.get("duration_ms", 0),
        summary=f"gitleaks: {len(findings)} potential secret(s)", findings=findings, raw=None)

# Add src/rush/tools/secrets.py::challenge_detection, source_manifest,
# and source_bound_history.
def challenge_detection(root, *, challenge_rule, config_path, permissions):
    import hashlib, json, secrets, tempfile, tomllib
    from pathlib import Path
    from ..engines import ENGINES
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    from ..runtime.binaries import resolve_binary
    from ..runtime.subprocesses import run_subprocess
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    allowed,missing=check_permissions(ExecutionPermissions(slow=True),permissions)
    if not allowed:
        raise PermissionError(", ".join(missing))
    root=root.resolve()
    config=PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(config_path,purpose="read")
    config_bytes=config.read_bytes()
    parsed_config=tomllib.loads(config_bytes.decode())
    if parsed_config.get("extend",{}).get("path"):
        raise ValueError("canary challenge requires self-contained config or extend.useDefault; external extend.path is not pinned")
    config_digest=hashlib.sha256(config_bytes).hexdigest()
    binary=resolve_binary("gitleaks")
    if not binary:
        raise FileNotFoundError("gitleaks executable absent")
    if challenge_rule=="generic-api-key":
        value="rush-canary-"+secrets.token_hex(24)
        line="api_key = '"+value+"'\n"
    elif challenge_rule=="aws-access-token":
        value="AKIA"+"".join(secrets.choice("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567") for _ in range(16))
        line="aws_access_key_id = '"+value+"'\n"
    else:
        raise ValueError("supported generated canaries: generic-api-key, aws-access-token")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-canary-") as folder:
        scratch=Path(folder).resolve()
        canary=scratch/"rush_canary.env"; canary.write_text(line)
        argv=[binary,"dir",str(scratch),"--config",str(config),"--report-format","json",
              "--report-path","-","--no-banner","--redact=100"]
        process=run_subprocess(argv,cwd=root,timeout=60)
        result=ENGINES["gitleaks"].normalize(
            {"stdout":process.stdout,"stderr":process.stderr,"exit_code":process.returncode},
            scratch,"secrets")
        if result["status"] not in {"ok","fail"}:
            raise ValueError("canary scanner report unusable")
        detected=any(f["rule"]==challenge_rule and Path(f["path"]).resolve()==canary
                     for f in result["findings"])
        redacted=value not in json.dumps(result)
    if hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=config_digest:
        raise ValueError("scanner configuration changed during challenge")
    return {"rule":challenge_rule,"detected":detected,"redacted":redacted,
            "status":"passed" if detected and redacted else "failed",
            "config_digest":config_digest,"engine_version":result["engine_version"],
            "canary_digest":hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
            "scope":"synthetic directory scan; does not prove Git-history coverage"}

def source_manifest(root):
    import hashlib
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    root=root.resolve(); physical=PhysicalRoot(root)
    hashes={}
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        relative=path.relative_to(root)
        if any(part in {".git",".rush"} for part in relative.parts):
            continue
        checked=physical.open_contained(relative,purpose="read")
        if checked.is_file():
            hashes[relative.as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(checked.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return hashes

def source_bound_history(root, result, *, before_manifest, prior_result_id=None,
                         record_result=False, permissions=None):
    import hashlib, json, os, re, tempfile
    from pathlib import Path
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    root=root.resolve(); physical=PhysicalRoot(root)
    hashes=source_manifest(root)
    if hashes != before_manifest:
        raise ValueError("source changed during secret scan")
    fingerprints=set()
    for finding in result.get("findings",[]):
        path=Path(finding["path"])
        relative=(path.relative_to(root) if path.is_absolute() else path)
        checked=physical.open_contained(relative,purpose="read")
        digest=hashes.get(relative.as_posix())
        if digest is None:
            raise ValueError("finding source absent from scanned tree")
        identity=[relative.as_posix(),digest,finding.get("line"),finding.get("rule")]
        fingerprints.add(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(identity).encode()).hexdigest())
    payload={"schema_version":1,"project_root":str(root),"source_hashes":hashes,
             "fingerprints":sorted(fingerprints)}
    metadata={"current_fingerprints":sorted(fingerprints),"recurring_fingerprints":[],
              "prior_source_changed":False}
    if prior_result_id is not None:
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",prior_result_id):
            raise ValueError("prior_result_id must be content digest")
        path=physical.open_contained(".rush/secret-scans/"+prior_result_id+".json",purpose="read")
        raw=path.read_bytes()
        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=prior_result_id:
            raise ValueError("stored result digest mismatch")
        previous=json.loads(raw)
        if previous.get("schema_version")!=1 or previous.get("project_root")!=str(root):
            raise ValueError("foreign or unsupported previous result")
        if not isinstance(previous.get("fingerprints"),list) or not isinstance(previous.get("source_hashes"),dict):
            raise ValueError("malformed previous result")
        metadata["recurring_fingerprints"]=sorted(fingerprints & set(previous["fingerprints"]))
        metadata["prior_source_changed"]=previous["source_hashes"]!=hashes
        metadata["prior_evidence"]="content-addressed historical result; not fresh execution"
    if record_result:
        allowed,missing=check_permissions(ExecutionPermissions(cache_write=True),permissions)
        if not allowed:
            raise PermissionError(", ".join(missing))
        if result.get("status") not in {"ok","fail"}:
            raise ValueError("cannot record incomplete secret scan")
        directory=physical.open_contained(".rush/secret-scans",purpose="write")
        directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        raw=json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
        digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(); destination=directory/(digest+".json")
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=directory,delete=False) as output:
            temporary=Path(output.name); output.write(raw); output.flush(); os.fsync(output.fileno())
        try:
            try:
                os.link(temporary,destination)
            except FileExistsError:
                if destination.read_bytes()!=raw:
                    raise ValueError("stored result collision")
        finally:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        metadata["result_id"]=digest
    return metadata

Proposed operation writes a known fake token pattern into isolated checkout, runs exact Gitleaks config/engine over that scope, and reports whether scanner detects and redacts canary. The canary is generated locally, never logged verbatim, and never added to original repository.

~~~python
# Replace src/rush/tools/secrets.py::SecretsTool.run.
def run(self, path, *, config=None, scope="history", prior_result_id=None, record_result=False,
        challenge_detection=False, challenge_rule="generic-api-key",
        config_path=None, permissions=None):
    import hashlib
    from ..engines import ENGINES
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    from .common import error_result
    root=(path if path.is_dir() else path.parent).resolve()
    if scope not in {"working_tree","history"} or not path.is_dir():
        return error_result(self.name,"gitleaks","scope must be working_tree or history; select a directory")
    args=["--scope",scope]
    if config_path is not None:
        selected=PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(config_path,purpose="read")
        args += ["--config",str(selected)]
    try:
        before_manifest=(source_manifest(root) if prior_result_id is not None or record_result
                         else None)
    except Exception as exc:
        return error_result(self.name,"gitleaks",f"source snapshot rejected: {type(exc).__name__}")
    result=run_engine(ENGINES["gitleaks"],path,args,tool_name=self.name)
    metadata=result.setdefault("metadata",{})
    metadata["scope"]={"kind":scope,"root":str(root),"selected_file_filter":False}
    try:
        if prior_result_id is not None or record_result:
            if scope != "working_tree":
                return error_result(self.name,"gitleaks","source-bound history requires scope=working_tree; Git-history findings need commit/blob identity")
            metadata["history"]=source_bound_history(root,result,before_manifest=before_manifest,
                prior_result_id=prior_result_id,record_result=record_result,permissions=permissions)
        if challenge_detection:
            if config_path is None:
                return error_result(self.name,"gitleaks","challenge requires explicit config_path")
            # Global function lookup avoids shadowing by the public bool parameter.
            metadata["detection_challenge"]=globals()["challenge_detection"](
                root,challenge_rule=challenge_rule,config_path=config_path,permissions=permissions)
            if metadata["detection_challenge"]["status"]=="failed" and result["status"]=="ok":
                result["status"]="warn"
    except Exception as exc:
        return error_result(self.name,"gitleaks",type(exc).__name__)
    return result

# Replace src/rush/engines/gitleaks.py::GitleaksEngine.run.
# Existing imports EngineResult, resolve_binary, run_subprocess, ownership_kwargs
# are already defined in that module.
def run(self, path, args, cwd=None, *, owner_instance_id=None, run_id=None):
    if len(args) not in {2,4} or args[0]!="--scope" or args[1] not in {"working_tree","history"}:
        raise ValueError("Gitleaks adapter requires explicit --scope")
    if len(args)==4 and args[2]!="--config":
        raise ValueError("Gitleaks adapter accepts only --config PATH after scope")
    operation="git" if args[1]=="history" else "dir"
    proc=run_subprocess(
        [resolve_binary(self.binary) or self.binary,operation,str(path),
         "--report-format","json","--report-path","-","--no-banner","--redact=100",*args[2:]],
        cwd=cwd,timeout=120,**ownership_kwargs(owner_instance_id,run_id))
    return EngineResult(exit_code=proc.returncode,stdout=proc.stdout,stderr=proc.stderr)

# Replace src/rush/tools/secrets.py::SecretsTool.__call__.
def __call__(self, path: Path, *, scope: str="history", prior_result_id: str | None=None,
             record_result: bool=False, challenge_detection: bool=False,
             challenge_rule: str="generic-api-key", config_path: str | None=None,
             allow_cache_write: bool=False, allow_slow: bool=False):
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions
    return self.run(path,scope=scope,prior_result_id=prior_result_id,record_result=record_result,
        challenge_detection=challenge_detection,challenge_rule=challenge_rule,
        config_path=config_path,permissions=ExecutionPermissions(
            cache_write=allow_cache_write,slow=allow_slow))

## Command 18/79 — `rush_sbom` (Q18)

**CLI/MCP/agent-memory-token integration:** Output/inventory-comparison fields need catalog Click options and matching `SbomTool.__call__` parameters for FastMCP. Agents consume verified artifact digests and component receipts in `ToolResult`; `rush_sbom` has no current memory or token-budget path. Repeat generation depends on Command 45/79 (W18)'s proposed, unimplemented OCI module; controlled adapter checks prove schema/publication logic only.

**Use:** create software bill of materials for an explicitly selected artifact/project. Existing grant, containment and overwrite checks are useful (`tools/sbom.py:62–82`). cdxgen supplies generation.

**Defect:** Tool adds artifact path for any non-skipped status, including error, and adapter treats exit 0 as generated without reading/validating output (`tools/sbom.py:84–105`, `engines/cdxgen.py:36–57`). A listed path can therefore be a phantom artifact.

**Fix target:** Replace `SbomTool.run` with the complete method below. Generate into an initially absent private output, validate CycloneDX 1.5/1.6 and component names, then publish atomically with no-clobber semantics unless overwrite was explicitly requested. A freshly regenerated identical SBOM is valid; comparing old/new hashes cannot establish freshness. Empty inventory and missing component versions return warning plus explicit counts. Process success alone never registers an artifact.

**Non-innovative product expansion / fix continuation (proposed):** Return `metadata.sbom={path,sha256,component_count,unversioned_components,inventory_empty,fresh_output}`. `source_digest` belongs to the separate two-run inventory comparison, not a single SBOM. Security consumers must re-read `path` through `read_verified_sbom(path, sha256, root=target_root)` before use; license/attest handoff must apply the same reader if those consumers accept this artifact. Tampering after generation raises `ValueError("SBOM digest mismatch")` before a network query or downstream artifact is produced. Before: zero-exit cdxgen can yield a phantom path. After: consumers receive a fresh schema-validated digest and reject byte drift before use.

**Acceptance (proposed):** `tests/test_sbom.py::test_zero_exit_without_file_is_error` expects `artifacts=[]`; `::test_stale_or_malformed_output_rejected`; `::test_valid_cyclonedx_component_identity` expects exact component count/version; denied write makes zero cdxgen calls.

~~~python
# Replace src/rush/tools/sbom.py::SbomTool.run.
def run(self, path, *, output_path=None, overwrite=False, config=None, permissions=None):
    import hashlib, json, os, tempfile
    from ..engines import ENGINES
    from .common import skipped_result
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    from ..io.physical_paths import ContainmentError, PhysicalRoot
    required = ExecutionPermissions(artifact_write=True)
    start = now_ms()
    allowed, missing = check_permissions(required, permissions)
    if not allowed:
        return skipped_result(self.name, "cdxgen", ", ".join(missing))
    if type(overwrite) is not bool:
        return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", "overwrite must be boolean")
    root = (path if path.is_dir() else path.parent).absolute()
    physical = PhysicalRoot(root)
    requested = Path(output_path) if output_path is not None else Path("rush-sbom.json")
    try:
        # Preserve the existing public absolute-path contract while validating
        # only a root-relative path through PhysicalRoot.
        if requested.is_absolute():
            requested = requested.relative_to(root)
        output = physical.open_contained(requested, purpose="write")
        if output.exists() and not overwrite:
            return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", "output already exists")
        if not output.parent.is_dir():
            return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", "output parent absent")
        runs = physical.open_contained(".rush/runs", purpose="write")
        runs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sbom-", dir=runs) as folder:
            fresh = Path(folder) / "bom.json"
            result = run_engine(ENGINES["cdxgen"], path,
                ["--output", str(fresh), "--spec-version", "1.6", "--no-install-deps", "--fail-on-error"],
                tool_name=self.name, permissions=permissions, required_permissions=required)
            result.pop("artifacts", None)
            if result["status"] != "ok":
                return result
            if fresh.is_symlink() or not fresh.is_file():
                return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", "fresh output missing")
            raw = fresh.read_bytes()
            document = json.loads(raw)
            components = document.get("components")
            if (document.get("bomFormat") != "CycloneDX"
                or document.get("specVersion") not in {"1.5", "1.6"}
                or not isinstance(components, list)
                or any(not isinstance(c, dict) or not isinstance(c.get("name"), str)
                       or not c["name"] for c in components)):
                return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", "unsupported or malformed CycloneDX")
            # Unknown versions remain explicit; an SBOM component may legitimately
            # omit version. Never manufacture one or call it verified.
            unidentified = sum(not isinstance(c.get("version"), str) or not c["version"]
                               for c in components)
            output = physical.open_contained(requested, purpose="write")
            if overwrite:
                os.replace(fresh, output)
            else:
                # Atomic no-clobber publish; another writer cannot be overwritten.
                os.link(fresh, output)
                fresh.unlink()
            result["artifacts"] = [str(output)]
            result.setdefault("metadata", {})["sbom"] = {
                "path": str(output), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                "component_count": len(components), "unversioned_components": unidentified,
                "inventory_empty": not components, "fresh_output": True}
            result["status"] = "warn" if unidentified or not components else "ok"
            result["summary"] = f"SBOM validated: {len(components)} components"
            result["duration_ms"] = elapsed_ms(start)
            return result
    except (ContainmentError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as exc:
        return error_result(self.name, "cdxgen", f"SBOM output rejected: {type(exc).__name__}")

# Add these functions to src/rush/tools/sbom.py.
def read_verified_sbom(path, expected_sha256, *, root):
    import hashlib, json, re
    from pathlib import Path
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    root=Path(root).absolute(); path=Path(path)
    relative=path.relative_to(root) if path.is_absolute() else path
    checked=PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(relative,purpose="read")
    if not isinstance(expected_sha256,str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",expected_sha256):
        raise ValueError("expected SHA-256 required")
    raw=checked.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=expected_sha256:
        raise ValueError("SBOM digest mismatch")
    bom=json.loads(raw)
    if (not isinstance(bom,dict) or bom.get("bomFormat")!="CycloneDX"
        or bom.get("specVersion") not in {"1.5","1.6"}
        or not isinstance(bom.get("components"),list)
        or any(not isinstance(c,dict) or not isinstance(c.get("name"),str)
               or not c["name"] for c in bom["components"])):
        raise ValueError("unsupported or malformed CycloneDX")
    return bom

def compare_sbom_inventories(root, *, permissions, runtime_path, image_ref):
    import hashlib, json, tempfile
    from collections import Counter
    from ..runtime.isolated_process import run_isolated_argv
    from pathlib import Path
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    from ..io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    allowed,missing=check_permissions(
        ExecutionPermissions(build=True,slow=True,artifact_write=True),permissions)
    if not allowed:
        raise PermissionError(", ".join(missing))
    root=root.resolve()
    def source_identity():
        identity={}
        for file in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
            relative=file.relative_to(root)
            if ".rush" in relative.parts or ".git" in relative.parts:
                continue
            checked=PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(relative,purpose="read")
            if checked.is_file():
                identity[relative.as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(checked.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        return identity
    before=source_identity()
    runs=PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(".rush/runs",purpose="write")
    runs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    directory=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="inventory-pair-",dir=runs))
    normalized=[]; artifacts=[]
    for index in (0,1):
        output=directory/f"inventory-{index}.json"
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-bom-child-") as folder:
            scratch=Path(folder).resolve()
            process=run_isolated_argv(root,scratch,runtime_path=runtime_path,image_ref=image_ref,
                entrypoint="cdxgen",argv=["/work","--output","/out/bom.json",
                    "--spec-version","1.6","--no-install-deps","--fail-on-error"],timeout_s=180)
            fresh=scratch/"bom.json"
            if process.returncode or not fresh.is_file() or fresh.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("isolated inventory generation incomplete")
            raw=fresh.read_bytes(); digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
            bom=read_verified_sbom(fresh,digest,root=scratch)
            output.write_bytes(raw)
        rows=[]
        for component in bom["components"]:
            version=component.get("version")
            if not isinstance(version,str) or not version:
                raise ValueError("versionless component cannot establish repeatability")
            hashes=component.get("hashes",[])
            if not isinstance(hashes,list) or any(
                not isinstance(h,dict) or not isinstance(h.get("alg"),str)
                or not isinstance(h.get("content"),str) for h in hashes):
                raise ValueError("component hash evidence malformed")
            rows.append(json.dumps({"purl":component.get("purl"),"group":component.get("group"),
                "name":component["name"],"version":version,"type":component.get("type"),
                "hashes":sorted((h["alg"],h["content"]) for h in hashes)},sort_keys=True))
        normalized.append(Counter(rows)); artifacts.append(str(output))
    after=source_identity()
    if before!=after:
        raise ValueError("source/lockfiles changed between inventories")
    removed=list((normalized[0]-normalized[1]).elements())
    added=list((normalized[1]-normalized[0]).elements())
    return {"status":"drift" if added or removed else "repeatable_inventory",
            "added":[json.loads(row) for row in sorted(added)],
            "removed":[json.loads(row) for row in sorted(removed)],
            "source_digest":hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(before,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
            "artifacts":artifacts,"comparison":"component identity/version/hash multiset"}

# Add src/rush/tools/security.py::audit_verified_sbom.
def audit_verified_sbom(root, sbom_path, expected_sha256, *, permissions):
    import json, time
    from urllib.parse import unquote
    from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
    from .sbom import read_verified_sbom
    from .base import ToolResult
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    started=time.monotonic()
    allowed,missing=check_permissions(ExecutionPermissions(network=True),permissions)
    if not allowed:
        raise PermissionError(", ".join(missing))
    bom=read_verified_sbom(sbom_path,expected_sha256,root=root)
    pending=[]; unresolved=[]
    for component in bom["components"]:
        purl=component.get("purl"); version=component.get("version")
        if (not isinstance(purl,str) or not purl.startswith("pkg:")
            or "@" not in purl.split("?")[0] or not isinstance(version,str)
            or unquote(purl.split("?")[0].rsplit("@",1)[1])!=version):
            unresolved.append(component["name"]); continue
        pending.append((purl,{"package":{"purl":purl}}))
    findings=[]; pages=0
    while pending:
        if pages>=20:
            raise ValueError("OSV page budget exhausted; no complete verdict")
        current=pending[:100]; pending=pending[100:]; pages+=1
        request=Request("https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch",
            data=json.dumps({"queries":[query for _,query in current]}).encode(),
            headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},method="POST")
        with urlopen(request,timeout=30) as response:
            raw=response.read(4_000_001)
        if len(raw)>4_000_000:
            raise ValueError("OSV response exceeds bound")
        records=json.loads(raw).get("results")
        if not isinstance(records,list) or len(records)!=len(current):
            raise ValueError("OSV result cardinality mismatch")
        for (purl,query),record in zip(current,records):
            if not isinstance(record,dict) or not isinstance(record.get("vulns",[]),list):
                raise ValueError("OSV result malformed")
            for vulnerability in record.get("vulns",[]):
                identifier=vulnerability.get("id")
                if not isinstance(identifier,str) or not identifier:
                    raise ValueError("OSV vulnerability ID absent")
                findings.append({"path":str(sbom_path),"line":None,"rule":identifier,
                    "severity":"warn","message":purl+": advisory "+identifier})
            token=record.get("next_page_token")
            if token:
                if not isinstance(token,str) or query.get("page_token")==token:
                    raise ValueError("invalid/repeated OSV page token")
                pending.append((purl,{**query,"page_token":token}))
    return ToolResult(tool="security",engine="osv-api",engine_version=None,
        status="warn" if findings or unresolved else "ok",
        duration_ms=max(0,round((time.monotonic()-started)*1000)),
        summary=f"SBOM advisory lookup: {len(findings)} findings; {len(unresolved)} unresolved",
        findings=findings,raw=None,metadata={"sbom_sha256":expected_sha256,
            "evidence_source":"digest-bound imported inventory","unresolved":unresolved,
            "endpoint":"https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch"})

## Command 19/79 — `rush_coverage` (Q19)

**CLI/MCP/agent-memory-token integration:** Base/test/trial/model/runtime fields need catalog Click forwarding and matching `CoverageTool.__call__` parameters for FastMCP. Agents consume measured counts and source-bound gap evidence in `ToolResult`; `rush_coverage` has no current memory or token-budget path. Candidate-test execution depends on Command 45/79 (W18)'s proposed OCI module and Command 48/79 (W21)'s proposed local-model adapter; both are unimplemented prerequisites, so deterministic adapters prove controller behavior only.

**Use:** assess exercised behavior after tests. Import mode parses LCOV/Cobertura/coverage.py JSON, validates containment and computes percentages (`tools/coverage.py:72–129,209–244`). This is real report analysis, not fresh execution proof.

**Reproduced execution gap:** Live-mode dispatch runs `coverage run -m pytest`/pytest-cov but returns exit status/raw stdout with `metrics=None` (`:176–206`). It does not establish measured coverage. Undercover alternative measures untested diff blocks, a different metric (`engines/undercover.py:71–104`). Writing `.coverage` also needs explicit artifact semantics.

**Fix specification:** In `src/rush/tools/coverage.py::CoverageTool.run`, replace live-mode exit-only return (`:176–206`) with one owned run directory: set `COVERAGE_FILE` there, run `coverage run -m pytest <selected tests>`, then `coverage json -o <run>/coverage.json`; require slow/build plus artifact-write for the fresh report. Parse that exact file through existing `_coverage_percent` and add validated `metrics={line_percent,covered_lines,total_lines}` from JSON totals, `metadata={evidence_source:"executed-runner",source_digest,report_digest,test_exit,collected_tests,measurement:"line"}` and contained `artifacts`. No report, zero collected tests, or failed export is incomplete/error, even when process exit is zero; imported mode remains labeled imported.

**Non-innovative product expansion (proposed):** Add optional `changed_lines` derived from an explicit Git base and return uncovered changed-line identifiers only when report paths/digests match source; branch coverage is a separate metric, never inferred from line percent. Capability test: `tests/test_coverage.py::test_changed_line_source_digest_guard` changes covered source after report and expects changed-line evidence invalidated.

**Acceptance (proposed):** `tests/test_coverage.py::test_live_partial_coverage_counts` fixture with one covered and one uncovered branch expects actual counts and `<100%`; `::test_missing_fresh_report_not_ok`, `::test_zero_tests_incomplete`, `::test_import_not_current_execution` assert distinct states.

# Add src/rush/tools/coverage.py::run_measured_coverage.
# Replace CoverageTool.run's entire "# 2. Executed mode" branch with:
# return run_measured_coverage(path, permissions=permissions,
#                              test_paths=test_paths, branch=bool(trial_gap_test))
def run_measured_coverage(path, *, permissions, test_paths=(), branch=False):
    import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, tempfile, time
    from xml.etree import ElementTree
    from ..permissions import ExecutionPermissions, check_permissions
    from ..runtime.binaries import resolve_binary
    from ..io.physical_paths import ContainmentError, PhysicalRoot
    started = time.monotonic()
    required = ExecutionPermissions(slow=True, build=True, artifact_write=True)
    allowed, missing = check_permissions(required, permissions)
    if not allowed:
        return skipped_result("coverage", "coverage", ", ".join(missing))
    binary = resolve_binary("coverage")
    if not binary:
        return skipped_result("coverage", "coverage", "coverage executable missing")
    root = (path if path.is_dir() else path.parent).resolve()
    try:
        runs = PhysicalRoot(root).open_contained(".rush/runs", purpose="write")
        runs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="coverage-", dir=runs))
        junit, report = work / "tests.xml", work / "coverage.json"
        env = dict(os.environ, COVERAGE_FILE=str(work / ".coverage"))
        env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
        selected = [str((root / name).resolve()) for name in test_paths] if test_paths else [str(path.resolve())]
        if any(not Path(name).is_relative_to(root) for name in selected):
            raise ValueError("test path outside project")
        argv = [binary, "run", *(["--branch"] if branch else []),
                "--source=" + str(root), "--omit=*/.rush/*",
                "-m", "pytest", *selected, "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
                "--junitxml=" + str(junit)]
        test = run_subprocess(argv, cwd=root, env=env, timeout=300)
        if test.returncode not in (0, 1) or not junit.is_file():
            return error_result("coverage", "coverage", "test execution incomplete")
        cases = list(ElementTree.parse(junit).iter("testcase"))
        executed = [case for case in cases if case.find("skipped") is None]
        if not executed:
            return error_result("coverage", "coverage", "zero executed tests")
        export = run_subprocess([binary, "json", "-o", str(report)],
                                cwd=root, env=env, timeout=60)
        if export.returncode or not report.is_file() or report.is_symlink():
            return error_result("coverage", "coverage", "fresh coverage export missing")
        raw = report.read_text()
        payload = json.loads(raw)
        totals = payload["totals"]
        covered, total = totals["covered_lines"], totals["num_statements"]
        if (type(covered) is not int or type(total) is not int
            or not 0 <= covered <= total or total == 0):
            raise ValueError("invalid line counts")
        _coverage_percent(report, raw)  # Existing parser validates source format/range.
        source_hashes = {}; missing_lines = {}; missing_branches = {}
        for name, data in payload["files"].items():
            source = (root / name).resolve()
            if not source.is_relative_to(root) or not source.is_file():
                raise ValueError("coverage file outside source or absent")
            source_hashes[str(source.relative_to(root))] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            rel = str(source.relative_to(root))
            missing_lines[rel] = sorted(data.get("missing_lines", []))
            missing_branches[rel] = [tuple(pair) for pair in data.get("missing_branches", [])]
            if any(type(line) is not int or line < 1
                   for line in data.get("executed_lines", []) + data.get("missing_lines", [])):
                raise ValueError("invalid line evidence")
        status = "fail" if test.returncode else ("warn" if covered < total else "ok")
        return ToolResult(tool="coverage", engine="coverage",
            engine_version=str(payload["meta"]["version"]), status=status,
            duration_ms=int((time.monotonic()-started)*1000),
            summary=f"coverage: {covered}/{total} lines; {len(executed)} tests",
            findings=[], raw=None, artifacts=[str(report), str(junit)],
            metrics={"line_percent": 100 * covered / total, "covered_lines": covered,
                     "total_lines": total, "collected_tests": len(cases)},
            metadata={"evidence_source":"executed-runner","test_exit":test.returncode,
                      "measurement":"line","source_hashes":source_hashes,
                      "missing_lines":missing_lines,"missing_branches":missing_branches,
                      "report_digest":hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),
                      "argv":argv})
    except (ContainmentError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError,
            ElementTree.ParseError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        return error_result("coverage", "coverage", type(exc).__name__)

**Product-expansion implementation artifact — unexecuted:**

~~~python
# src/rush/tools/coverage.py::CoverageTool.run. `diff_text` is stdout from
# `git diff --unified=0 <verified-base-commit> -- <contained-root>`; require
# Git exit 0 and reject [TRUNCATED] before calling. `report` is fresh JSON.
import hashlib, re
from pathlib import Path
def changed_uncovered_lines(root, report, source_hashes, diff_text):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    changed = set(); current = None
    for line in diff_text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("+++ b/"):
            current = line[6:]
        elif line.startswith("+++ /dev/null"):
            current = None
        elif current is not None and (h := re.match(r"@@ -\d+(?:,\d+)? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@", line)):
            start, count = int(h.group(1)), int(h.group(2) or 1)
            changed.update((current, number) for number in range(start, start+count))
    out = []
    for name, evidence in report["files"].items():
        rel = (root / name).resolve().relative_to(root).as_posix()
        source = root / rel
        if hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != source_hashes[rel]:
            raise ValueError("source_digest_drift:" + rel)
        missing = set(evidence["missing_lines"])
        out.extend(f"{rel}:{number}" for path,number in changed
                   if path == rel and number in missing)
    return sorted(set(out))
def attach_changed_line_evidence(root, result, base_ref):
    from rush.tools.common import run_subprocess
    if result.get("metadata",{}).get("evidence_source") != "executed-runner":
        raise ValueError("fresh_coverage_required")
    base=run_subprocess(["git","rev-parse","--verify",f"{base_ref}^{{commit}}"],cwd=root)
    if base.returncode: raise ValueError("invalid_base_ref")
    diff=run_subprocess(["git","diff","--unified=0",base.stdout.strip(),"--","."],cwd=root)
    if diff.returncode or diff.stdout.endswith("[TRUNCATED]"):
        raise ValueError("changed_line_diff_incomplete")
    report=json.loads(Path(result["artifacts"][0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    result["metadata"]["uncovered_changed_lines"] = changed_uncovered_lines(
        root,report,result["metadata"]["source_hashes"],diff.stdout)
    result["metadata"]["base_commit"] = base.stdout.strip()
    return result

**Distinct agent-side expansion (proposed; unexecuted):** Add uncovered-branch test trial to `src/rush/tools/coverage.py::CoverageTool.run`. Existing coverage metric locates gaps; proposed operation asks connected specialist for assertion-bearing test targeting one uncovered branch, runs it in isolated checkout, regenerates fresh coverage, and checks the exact line/branch transitions from uncovered to covered. A test that executes no assertion or only raises overall percentage elsewhere is rejected; original tree remains unchanged.

~~~python
# Add to src/rush/tools/coverage.py. `trial_gap_test` is an optional
# __call__/run keyword forwarded through catalog CLI --trial-gap-test and MCP.
# Baseline is a FRESH run_measured_coverage(..., branch=True) result, never an
# imported claim. W21's proposed OfflineReviewTool._invoke_local_model is the
# pinned local generator; W18's run_isolated_argv executes candidate pytest.
import ast, hashlib, json, shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree
def gap_is_missing(report, target):
    path, sep, coordinate = target.rpartition(":")
    if not sep or path not in report["files"]: raise ValueError("unknown_gap")
    entry = report["files"][path]
    if "->" in coordinate:
        start,end = (int(x) for x in coordinate.split("->",1))
        return [start,end] in entry.get("missing_branches", [])
    return int(coordinate) in entry["missing_lines"]
def parse_gap_test_response(text):
    payload = json.loads(text)
    if payload.get("schema_version") != 1 or not isinstance(payload.get("test_source"), str):
        raise ValueError("invalid_gap_test_response")
    source = payload["test_source"]
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    tests = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
             and n.name.startswith("test_")]
    if len(tests) != 1 or not any(isinstance(n,ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(tests[0])):
        raise ValueError("assertion_test_required")
    return source, tests[0].name
def run_gap_candidate_isolated(root, test_source, test_name, runtime):
    from rush.runtime.isolated_process import run_isolated_argv
    root=Path(root).resolve()
    if any(p.is_symlink() for p in root.rglob("*")):
        raise ValueError("project_symlink_in_trial_scope")
    script = ('import json,sys,coverage,pytest\n'
              'sys.path.insert(0,"/work/src")\n'
              'sys.path.insert(0,"/work")\n'
              'cov=coverage.Coverage(data_file="/out/.coverage",branch=True,source=["/work"])\n'
              'cov.start()\n'
              'code=pytest.main([sys.argv[1]+"::"+sys.argv[2],"-q","-p","no:cacheprovider","--junitxml=/out/tests.xml"])\n'
              'cov.stop();cov.save();cov.json_report(outfile="/out/coverage.json")\n'
              'open("/out/test-exit.json","w").write(json.dumps({"exit":int(code)}))\n')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-gap-") as temporary:
        project = Path(temporary)/"project"; output = Path(temporary)/"output"
        shutil.copytree(root, project, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(
            ".git",".rush",".venv","__pycache__",".env",".env.*"))
        output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        candidate = project/"tests"/"test_rush_gap_candidate.py"
        candidate.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        candidate.write_text(test_source,encoding="utf-8")
        completed = run_isolated_argv(project,output,
            runtime_path=runtime["runtime_path"],image_ref=runtime["coverage_image_ref"],
            entrypoint="/usr/bin/env",
            argv=["python","-c",script,"/work/tests/test_rush_gap_candidate.py",test_name],
            timeout_s=runtime["timeout_seconds"])
        if completed.returncode or not (output/"coverage.json").is_file() or not (output/"tests.xml").is_file():
            raise ValueError("candidate_execution_incomplete")
        tests = list(ElementTree.parse(output/"tests.xml").iter("testcase"))
        test_exit = json.loads((output/"test-exit.json").read_text())["exit"]
        report = json.loads((output/"coverage.json").read_text())
        return {"report":report,"test_passed":test_exit==0 and len(tests)==1,
                "test_count":len(tests),
                "candidate_sha256":hashlib.sha256(test_source.encode()).hexdigest()}
def trial_gap_candidate(root, target, baseline_report, runtime, *, local_model):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    if not gap_is_missing(baseline_report,target): raise ValueError("target_not_uncovered")
    path = target.rpartition(":")[0]
    source = (root/path).resolve(strict=True)
    if not source.is_relative_to(root): raise ValueError("source_outside_project")
    source_bytes = source.read_bytes()
    if len(source_bytes) > 65536: raise ValueError("source_too_large_for_model_prompt")
    before_hash = hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest()
    prompt = json.dumps({"target":target,"source_sha256":before_hash,
                         "source":source_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
                         "request":"Return JSON schema_version=1,test_source with one assertion test"})
    response = local_model(prompt,runtime,root,runtime["timeout_seconds"])
    candidate,test_name = parse_gap_test_response(response)
    measured = run_gap_candidate_isolated(root,candidate,test_name,runtime)
    if hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != before_hash:
        raise ValueError("source_changed_during_trial")
    status = gap_trial(target,{target},set() if not gap_is_missing(measured["report"],target) else {target},
                       measured["test_passed"],True)
    return {"status":status,"target":target,"test_node":"tests/test_rush_gap_candidate.py::"+test_name,
            "test_count":measured["test_count"],"candidate_sha256":measured["candidate_sha256"]}
# `coverage_image_ref` pins a local OCI image with Python, pytest, coverage
# and project test dependencies; W21 `image_ref` separately pins llama-cli.
# Integration call after W21 is installed: trial_gap_candidate(root,target,
# fresh_report,runtime,local_model=OfflineReviewTool()._invoke_local_model).
def coverage_trial_runtime(root, local_runtime_path, local_model_path,
                           local_model_image_ref, coverage_image_ref,
                           trial_timeout_seconds):
    import re
    root=Path(root).resolve()
    model=Path(local_model_path)
    if (model.is_absolute() or ".." in model.parts or
            not (root/model).resolve().is_relative_to(root) or not (root/model).is_file()):
        raise ValueError("model_path_not_contained")
    if (type(trial_timeout_seconds) is not int or trial_timeout_seconds < 1
            or trial_timeout_seconds > 600):
        raise ValueError("invalid_trial_timeout")
    for image in (local_model_image_ref,coverage_image_ref):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",image):
            raise ValueError("unpinned_trial_image")
    return {"runtime_path":str(Path(local_runtime_path).resolve()),
            "model_path":model.as_posix(),"image_ref":local_model_image_ref,
            "coverage_image_ref":coverage_image_ref,
            "timeout_seconds":trial_timeout_seconds}
def run_gap_trial_route(self, path, target, permissions, *, local_runtime_path,
                        local_model_path, local_model_image_ref,
                        coverage_image_ref, trial_timeout_seconds):
    from rush.tools.offline_runner import OfflineReviewTool
    from rush.runtime.isolated_process import IsolationUnavailable
    root=Path(path).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir(): raise ValueError("trial_requires_project_directory")
    baseline=run_measured_coverage(root,permissions=permissions,branch=True)
    if baseline["status"] in {"error","skipped"}: return baseline
    fresh_report=json.loads(Path(baseline["artifacts"][0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    runtime=coverage_trial_runtime(root,local_runtime_path,local_model_path,
                                   local_model_image_ref,coverage_image_ref,
                                   trial_timeout_seconds)
    try:
        trial=trial_gap_candidate(root,target,fresh_report,runtime,
            local_model=OfflineReviewTool()._invoke_local_model)
    except IsolationUnavailable:
        trial={"status":"inconclusive","reason":"isolation_unavailable"}
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        trial={"status":"inconclusive","reason":type(exc).__name__}
    baseline["metadata"]["gap_trial"]=trial

        return error_result("codeql", "codeql", "explicit approved build command required")

        return error_result("codeql", "codeql", "project directory and local query pack required")
    binary = resolve_binary("codeql")
    if not binary:
        return skipped_result("codeql", "codeql", "CodeQL executable missing")

        runs = physical.open_contained(".rush/runs", purpose="write")

        if create.returncode:

        if not _is_codeql_sarif(raw):

        findings = parse_structured_iac_report(raw, root)
        return ToolResult(tool="codeql", engine="codeql",
            engine_version=version.stdout.strip().splitlines()[0],
            status="warn" if findings else "ok",

            summary=f"CodeQL analysis: {len(findings)} findings",
            findings=findings, raw=None, artifacts=[str(sarif)],
            metadata={"evidence_source":"executed-analysis","database_path":str(db),

                "report_digest":hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),

**Fix-continuation implementation artifact — unexecuted:**

~~~python
# src/rush/tools/codeql.py::CodeqlTool.run. This is already performed inside
# run_codeql_analysis: PhysicalRoot.open_contained(query_pack), reject symlink
# and require qlpack.yml, hash each regular file into pack_hashes, then hash
# sorted JSON into pack_digest. No second resolver or unverifiable hash call.
def query_pack_identity(root, query_pack):
    from pathlib import Path
    from rush.io.physical_paths import PhysicalRoot
    import hashlib, json
    pack = PhysicalRoot(Path(root).resolve()).open_contained(query_pack, purpose="read")
    if not pack.is_dir() or not (pack / "qlpack.yml").is_file():
        raise ValueError("approved local qlpack.yml absent")
    hashes = {}
    for file in sorted(pack.rglob("*")):
        if file.is_symlink(): raise ValueError("query-pack symlink refused")
        if file.is_file():
            hashes[file.relative_to(pack).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return pack, hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(hashes,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

Budget exhaustion returns `budget_limited`; global smallest witness is not claimed.

~~~python
# Add to src/rush/tools/codeql.py. Python source reduction uses occurrence IDs
# and retains source/sink functions. Every predicate run calls W18's OCI
# provider for CodeQL database-create AND analyze in a fresh mounted copy.
# Other languages require their own syntax adapter;
# unsupported syntax returns explicit inconclusive, never a fake witness.
import ast, json, re, shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
def qualified_symbol(source, line):
    tree=ast.parse(source)
    found=[]
    def visit(nodes, prefix=()):
        for node in nodes:
            if isinstance(node,(ast.ClassDef,ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                if node.lineno <= line <= node.end_lineno:
                    name=(*prefix,node.name); found.append(".".join(name))
                    visit(node.body,name)
    visit(tree.body)
    return found[-1] if found else "<module>"
def endpoint_identity(root, physical_location):
    from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
    uri=physical_location["artifactLocation"]["uri"]
    line=physical_location["region"]["startLine"]
    if type(line) is not int or line < 1: raise ValueError("invalid_flow_line")
    if uri.startswith("file://"):
        container_path=unquote(urlsplit(uri).path)
        uri=(container_path[len("/work/"):] if container_path.startswith("/work/")
             else container_path)
    else:
        uri=unquote(uri)
    file=(Path(root)/uri).resolve(strict=True)
    if not file.is_relative_to(Path(root).resolve()): raise ValueError("flow_outside_project")
    uri=file.relative_to(Path(root).resolve()).as_posix()
    lines=file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    if line > len(lines): raise ValueError("flow_line_outside_file")
    snippet=re.sub(r"\s+","",lines[line-1])
    symbol=qualified_symbol("\n".join(lines),line) if file.suffix==".py" else "<text>"
    return (uri,symbol,snippet)
def codeql_flow_ids(root, sarif_path):
    data=json.loads(Path(sarif_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")); flows=[]
    for run in data["runs"]:
        for result in run.get("results",[]):
            for flow in result.get("codeFlows",[]):
                for thread in flow.get("threadFlows",[]):
                    locations=thread.get("locations",[])
                    if len(locations)<2: continue
                    source=locations[0]["location"]["physicalLocation"]
                    sink=locations[-1]["location"]["physicalLocation"]
                    flows.append((result["ruleId"],endpoint_identity(root,source),
                                  endpoint_identity(root,sink)))
    return flows
def function_occurrences(source, protected_symbols):
    tree=ast.parse(source); units=[]
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name not in protected_symbols:
            units.append((f"{node.name}@{node.lineno}",node.lineno,node.end_lineno))
    return units
def render_kept_functions(source, units, kept_ids):
    lines=source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for unit_id,start,end in sorted(units,key=lambda row:row[1],reverse=True):
        if unit_id not in kept_ids: del lines[start-1:end]
    rendered="".join(lines)
    ast.parse(rendered)
    return rendered
def isolated_codeql_candidate(project, query_pack, runtime, *, language, runner=None):
    if runner is None:
        from rush.runtime.isolated_process import run_isolated_argv
        runner=run_isolated_argv
    project=Path(project).resolve()
    pack=(project/query_pack).resolve(strict=True)
    if not pack.is_relative_to(project) or not (pack/"qlpack.yml").is_file():
        raise ValueError("query_pack_outside_candidate")
    relative_pack=pack.relative_to(project).as_posix()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-codeql-output-") as d:
        output=Path(d); entrypoint=runtime["codeql_entrypoint"]
        common={"runtime_path":runtime["runtime_path"],
                "image_ref":runtime["codeql_image_ref"],
                "entrypoint":entrypoint,"timeout_s":runtime["timeout_seconds"]}
        create=runner(project,output,
            argv=["database","create","/out/database","--language="+language,
                  "--source-root=/work"],**common)
        if create.returncode: raise ValueError("candidate_database_create_failed")
        analyze=runner(project,output,
            argv=["database","analyze","/out/database",
                  "/work/"+relative_pack,"--format=sarifv2.1.0",
                  "--sarif-add-snippets","--output=/out/results.sarif"],**common)
        sarif=output/"results.sarif"
        if analyze.returncode or not sarif.is_file() or sarif.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("candidate_database_analyze_failed")
        raw=sarif.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if not _is_codeql_sarif(raw): raise ValueError("candidate_sarif_invalid")
        return {"flows":codeql_flow_ids(project,sarif),
                "report_digest":__import__("hashlib").sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),
                "phases":[{"name":"database_create","exit":create.returncode},
                          {"name":"database_analyze","exit":analyze.returncode}]}
def codeql_witness_trial(tool, root, baseline_sarif, alert_index, query_pack,
                         permissions, runtime, *, max_attempts=20):
    root=Path(root).resolve(); flows=codeql_flow_ids(root,baseline_sarif)
    _, expected_pack_digest = query_pack_identity(root, query_pack)
    if type(alert_index) is not int or not 0 <= alert_index < len(flows):
        raise ValueError("unknown_flow_alert")
    expected=flows[alert_index]
    if expected[1][0] != expected[2][0] or not expected[1][0].endswith(".py"):
        return {"minimality":"inconclusive","reason":"syntax_adapter_unavailable"}
    relative=expected[1][0]; original=(root/relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    protected={expected[1][1].split(".")[0],expected[2][1].split(".")[0]}
    units=function_occurrences(original,protected)
    ledger=[]
    def preserves(kept):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rush-codeql-witness-") as d:
            scratch=Path(d)/"project"
            shutil.copytree(root,scratch,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".git",".rush",".venv","__pycache__"))
            (scratch/relative).write_text(render_kept_functions(original,units,set(kept)),encoding="utf-8")
            result=isolated_codeql_candidate(scratch,query_pack,runtime,language="python")
            _, candidate_pack_digest=query_pack_identity(scratch,query_pack)
            if candidate_pack_digest != expected_pack_digest:
                raise ValueError("candidate_query_pack_changed")
            ledger.append({"kept":list(kept),"phases":result["phases"],
                           "report_digest":result["report_digest"]})
            return expected in result["flows"]
    try: reduced=minimize_units([row[0] for row in units],preserves,max_attempts=max_attempts)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return {"minimality":"inconclusive","reason":str(exc),"ledger":ledger}
    return {"minimality":reduced["minimality"],"attempts":reduced["attempts"],
            "rule":expected[0],"source_sink":expected[1:],
            "query_pack_digest":expected_pack_digest,
            "minimal_source":render_kept_functions(original,units,set(reduced["units"])),
            "ledger":ledger}
def codeql_trial_runtime(isolation_runtime_path, codeql_image_ref,
                         codeql_entrypoint, trial_timeout_seconds):
    import re
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}",codeql_image_ref):
        raise ValueError("unpinned_codeql_image")
    if type(trial_timeout_seconds) is not int or not 1 <= trial_timeout_seconds <= 1800:
        raise ValueError("invalid_codeql_trial_timeout")
    if not codeql_entrypoint.startswith("/") or "\x00" in codeql_entrypoint:
        raise ValueError("invalid_codeql_entrypoint")
    return {"runtime_path":str(Path(isolation_runtime_path).resolve()),
            "codeql_image_ref":codeql_image_ref,
            "codeql_entrypoint":codeql_entrypoint,
            "timeout_seconds":trial_timeout_seconds}
def run_codeql_minimizer_route(self, path, language, query_pack, permissions,
                               alert_index, *, isolation_runtime_path,
                               codeql_image_ref, codeql_entrypoint,
                               trial_timeout_seconds):
    from rush.runtime.isolated_process import IsolationUnavailable
    baseline=run_codeql_analysis(self,path,language=language,
                                 query_pack=query_pack,permissions=permissions)
    if baseline["status"] in {"error","skipped"}: return baseline
    runtime=codeql_trial_runtime(isolation_runtime_path,codeql_image_ref,
                                 codeql_entrypoint,trial_timeout_seconds)
    try:
        trial=codeql_witness_trial(self,path,baseline["artifacts"][0],alert_index,
                                  query_pack,permissions,runtime)
    except IsolationUnavailable:
        trial={"minimality":"inconclusive","reason":"isolation_unavailable"}
    except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        trial={"minimality":"inconclusive","reason":type(exc).__name__}
    baseline["metadata"]["query_witness"]=trial
    return baseline

from rush.tools.codeql import _is_codeql_sarif
def fake_sarif(root):
    source=(Path(root)/"app.py").read_text(); lines=source.splitlines()

        results=[]

            return {"location":{"physicalLocation":{"artifactLocation":{"uri":"app.py"},
                    "region":{"startLine":line}}}}
        results=[{"ruleId":"py/sql-injection","codeFlows":[{"threadFlows":[{
            "locations":[point("request"),point("execute")]}]}]}]

~~~python
def minimize_units(units, preserves_flow, *, max_attempts=20):
    if type(max_attempts) is not int or max_attempts < 1: raise ValueError("invalid_budget")
    current = list(units); attempts = 1
    def result(state): return {"units":current, "minimality":state, "attempts":attempts}
    if not preserves_flow(current): return result("baseline_not_reproduced")
    while True:
        for index in range(len(current)):
            if attempts == max_attempts: return result("budget_limited")
            trial = current[:index] + current[index+1:]; attempts += 1
            if preserves_flow(trial):
                current = trial
                break
        else: return result("one_deletion_minimal")
flow = lambda units: "request" in units and "execute" in units and "sql_concat" in units
assert minimize_units(["helper","request","sql_concat","execute","log"], flow)["units"] == ["request","sql_concat","execute"]
assert not flow(["request","execute"])
assert minimize_units(["A","B"], lambda units: units in [["A","B"],["A"],[]])["units"] == []
assert minimize_units(["A","A"], lambda units: "A" in units)["units"] == ["A"]
assert minimize_units(["A","A"], lambda units: "A" in units, max_attempts=2)["minimality"] == "budget_limited"

# src/rush/tools/mutation.py:317-335. Replace mutmut-only overwrite with this
# complete staged-config builder. `tomli-w==1.2.0` is already in uv.lock;
# declare it directly in pyproject.toml if this helper is adopted.
import tomllib
import tomli_w
from hashlib import sha256
def staged_mutmut_pyproject(original_bytes, source_paths, test_paths):
    data = tomllib.loads(original_bytes.decode("utf-8")) if original_bytes else {}
    if not isinstance(data.get("tool", {}), dict):
        raise ValueError("invalid_tool_table")
    tool = data.setdefault("tool", {})
    mutmut = tool.setdefault("mutmut", {})
    if not isinstance(mutmut, dict):
        raise ValueError("invalid_mutmut_table")
    mutmut.update(source_paths=list(source_paths),
                  pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection=list(test_paths))
    staged = tomli_w.dumps(data).encode("utf-8")
    if "project" in data:
        assert tomllib.loads(staged.decode("utf-8"))["project"] == data["project"]
    return staged, {"source_pyproject_sha256": sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest(),
                    "staged_pyproject_sha256": sha256(staged).hexdigest()}
# Copy original root/pyproject.toml bytes into run_root before staging; write
# returned bytes there. Preserve declared dependencies, package metadata and
# pytest config. Source/test selection is supplied by shared catalog CLI
# callback patch in §6: --source-path/--test-path (multiple), --timeout-seconds.
~~~

from hashlib import sha256
def focused_mutant_argv(mutmut_bin, mutant_id, record, source_bytes):
    if sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest() != record["source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("stale_source")
    if mutant_id not in record["surviving_ids"]:

    return [mutmut_bin, "run", mutant_id]

~~~python
# src/rush/tools/e2e.py::E2eTool.run parser and argv adapter; use existing
# resolve_binary/run_subprocess. Public result maps state fail/error/skipped to
# canonical ToolResult, not process exit alone.
import json
def playwright_argv(binary, *, e2e_config=None, test_filter=None):
    argv = [binary, "test", "--reporter=json"]
    if e2e_config: argv += ["--config", str(e2e_config)]
    if test_filter: argv += ["--grep", test_filter]
    return argv
def parse_playwright_json(stdout, exit_code):
    try: report = json.loads(stdout)
    except (ValueError, TypeError): return {"status":"error","reason":"malformed_report"}
    tests = []
    def walk(suite):
        for spec in suite.get("specs", []):
            for test in spec.get("tests", []):
                results = test.get("results", [])
                outcome = results[-1].get("status") if results else "skipped"
                tests.append((spec, test, results, outcome))
        for nested in suite.get("suites", []): walk(nested)
    for suite in report.get("suites", []): walk(suite)
    if not tests: return {"status":"skipped","reason":"zero_tests"}
    if any(outcome not in {"passed","failed","skipped","timedOut","interrupted"}
           for _,_,_,outcome in tests):
        return {"status":"error","reason":"unknown_test_outcome"}
    failures = [(spec, test, results) for spec,test,results,outcome in tests
                if outcome in {"failed","timedOut","interrupted"}]
    findings = [{"path":spec.get("file") or test.get("file"),
                 "line":(spec.get("line") or test.get("line")),
                 "test_title":spec.get("title"),
                 "message":((results[-1].get("errors") or [{}])[0].get("message", ""))}
                for spec,test,results in failures]
    metrics = {"collected":len(tests),
               "passed":sum(outcome == "passed" for *_,outcome in tests),
               "failed":len(failures),
               "skipped":sum(outcome == "skipped" for *_,outcome in tests)}
    status = "fail" if failures else "error" if exit_code else "ok"
    return {"status":status,"metrics":metrics,"findings":findings}
# At callsite: binary=resolve_binary("playwright"); skip if None; version=
# run_subprocess([binary,"--version"], cwd=root); require returncode=0 and
# nonempty stdout. Run playwright_argv(binary,...) with same absolute binary;
# pass proc.stdout/proc.returncode to parser; contain config/test paths first.
~~~
